title: The Global Kodaira--Fredholm Cocycle Patching Theorem: Bridging Local Analytic Fredholm Divisors to Global Algebraic Line Bundle Sections on Projective Manifolds
description: Formal Lean 4 machine-certified proof and numerical verification of the Global Kodaira--Fredholm Cocycle Patching Theorem, proving that twisted Fredholm determinants satisfy exact 1-cocycle conditions and assemble into global algebraic sections of O_X(k). In this work, ai is being used as a tool to assist in formal verification, symbol auditing, and manuscript preparation.
